data.body: **P2 — Propagate the invocation context into map/parallel workers.** This copies the host/plugin `Context` only into `invoke_worker`. The concurrency executor later submits each branch to a separate `ThreadPoolExecutor` without `copy_context()`, so `ContextVar` bindings installed by `on_invocation_start`—including OTel baggage—are absent inside public `map` and `parallel` branch functions. Capture a fresh context for each branch submission and run `_branch_worker` through it, with a regression test covering visibility and isolation across branches.
